A column cut from the local paper.

## The Text

### Lights Seen Over the Teeth

Fishermen returning late on Tuesday report lights moving low over the rocks known as the Teeth, a mile beyond the harbour mouth. Three crews describe the same thing: a slow line of pale green lamps that kept pace with no boat and showed no hull.

The harbourmaster, Mr H. Marsh, told this paper the lights were "reflections off the fog and nothing more," and reminded masters that the Teeth are closed to traffic after dark.

Mrs Ada Crane, whose husband did not return from the same water last spring, said only that she had seen the lights before.
